name: pocket-near
description: Non-custodial NEAR Intents companion for Telegram

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/bot" "npm run dev --prefix apps/mini-app"
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --prefix apps/bot
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --prefix apps/mini-app
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --prefix apps/bot && npm run build --prefix apps/mini-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/bot && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/mini-app
